changelog: - **The Seawater desalination Template now runs on a day of demand.** A 24-hour demand table and six run rules move the plant: the Delivery pump follows the demand, and each stage before it refills the tank after it, so every tank takes up part of the day. The demand curve and every plant figure are example assumptions, and the notes say so. The Template opens on a wider overview of its five frames. A table's name and source now follow the language, and the Target run section shows the source of the table it reads.
